sections.title: Little Rock Industry Specializations
sections.description: Deep expertise in Little Rock's key industry verticals.

blocks.heading: Healthcare (UAMS's Academic Medical Leadership)
paragraphs: University of Arkansas for Medical Sciences (UAMS, Little Rock campus) is Arkansas's only academic health sciences university — combining a medical school, nursing school, pharmacy school, and the UAMS Medical Center hospital:
Clinical AI for UAMS Medical Center's complex patient population — Arkansas has significant health disparities affecting rural and low-income populations that clinical AI can help address.
Clinical research AI for UAMS's research programs in cancer, heart disease, and rural health.
Population health analytics for Arkansas Medicaid (traditional Medicaid and Arkansas Works managed care).
Baptist Health (Little Rock HQ, Arkansas's largest not-for-profit healthcare system) and CHI St. Vincent complete Little Rock's hospital community with similar clinical AI needs.
Cost: $45,000–$120,000 | Timeline: 12–22 weeks

blocks.heading: Arkansas Agriculture (Rice and Poultry)
paragraphs: Arkansas is the US's largest rice-producing state and a major broiler chicken producing state — creating agricultural AI requirements as specific as any state in the South:
Rice production AI: Water management ML for Arkansas's water-intensive rice production, yield prediction from satellite and sensor data, and harvest timing optimization.
Poultry analytics: Broiler house performance AI for Tyson Foods (Springdale AR HQ, Springdale is near Fayetteville — accessible Arkansas market) and Simmons Foods suppliers.
Soybean and cotton optimization: Precision agriculture for Arkansas's second and third most important field crops.
Cost: $35,000–$95,000 | Timeline: 10–20 weeks

blocks.heading: State Government
paragraphs: Arkansas state agencies — the Arkansas Department of Finance and Administration, Department of Health, and Department of Human Services — are among the state's largest technology purchasers. Analytics AI for state government programs and document processing automation for Arkansas's administrative operations.
Cost: $20,000–$75,000 | Timeline: 8–18 weeks

blocks.heading: Walmart Ecosystem (Bentonville Influence)
paragraphs: Walmart's Bentonville HQ (3 hours northwest of Little Rock) shapes Arkansas's entire commercial landscape. The supplier community serving Walmart's corporate offices and distribution network creates AI demand for retail analytics, supply chain intelligence, and vendor compliance tools. ClickMasters serves Arkansas's Walmart supplier ecosystem from Little Rock's service area.
Cost: $30,000–$90,000 | Timeline: 10–20 weeks
